newsitem.title: GERMANY: U.S. soldier convicted of rape in base in Germany.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soldier convicted of rape in base in Germany.

text.p: A U.S. military court found an army sergeant guilty on Thursday of raping and sodomising female soldiers at an army base in Germany.

Sergeant First Class Paul Fuller, 26, of Columbus, Ohio, was convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sodomy involving three female soldiers as well as three counts of cruelty and one count of kidnapping.

Fuller was found not guilty on one count of attempted rape and obstruction of justice but was found guilty of one count each of unlawfully entering a soldier's room, fraternisation with a lower-ranking soldier and indecent assault.
Fuller showed no emotion as the verdict was read out by a member of the jury, made up of four men and two women.
The jury was set to decide on Fuller's sentence later in the day. Military officials said the maximum penalty Fuller could face would be life in jail.

Another soldier at the base, Sergeant First Class Julius Davis, 37, of Fayetteville, North Carolina, was cleared last week of rape and sodomy but given two years jail after being found guilty of lesser charges, including indecent assault.
